answer_1.quote: We provide raw conversations to the LLM and instruct it to explain observed behavior from a cultural perspective. ... Summarize the conversation in 3-4 sentences.
answer_1.outputs: Summaries of conversations and descriptions of cultural norms and violations

answer_3.quote: We employ self-verification and multi-agent verification to refine the dataset. ... We use instances of GPT-4o-mini for each agent in the framework.

answer_4.quote: We use three native culture annotators for these tasks. ... We ask humans to (1) judge the relevance of the LLM-generated description to the conversation, (2) judge whether the mapping of the norm concept to the description is accurate, and (3) judge whether or not the norm concept is violated in that particular conversation.
answer_4.guideline: Humans judge relevance, mapping accuracy, and violation status via binary yes/no answers.
